topologyPolicy.decision: Use route groups for walked official route topology and connections for transfers between route entries.

routeGroupKinds.mainline: Primary continuous official section chain for the selected trail model.
routeGroupKinds.branch: Official alternate or side branch that can be hiked as trail, but should not be silently merged into the mainline.
routeGroupKinds.access: Official or strongly supported approach route to/from public transport, village, trailhead or another trail.
routeGroupKinds.connector: Walked link between route groups or nearby route sections where it is part of the trail model.

topologyPolicy.connectionsUse: Use connections.json-style records for non-section transfers or continuity records between sections: ferry, bus, road transfer, rowboat, short walk transfer, same-island continuity, or mode none for a known gap with no usable transfer geometry.
topologyPolicy.officialRowboatRule: If a rowboat crossing is an official route entry in its own right, model it as a section route with strong warnings. Otherwise model it as a rowboat connection or access/side metadata.
